claims: The Apple iPhone Air was released in September 2025.
The Apple iPhone Air is 5.64 mm thick.
The Apple iPhone Air weighs 165 grams.
The Apple iPhone Air features a 6.5-inch display.
The Apple iPhone Air has a titanium frame.
The Apple iPhone Air is equipped with the A19 Pro chip.
The Apple iPhone Air has a single 48MP Fusion rear camera.
The Apple iPhone Air has no dedicated ultra-wide lens.
The Apple iPhone Air is the thinnest iPhone ever.
The Apple iPhone Air is marketed as offering "all-day" battery life.
The Apple iPhone Air has reduced battery capacity due to the thin chassis.
The Apple iPhone Air exclusively uses eSIM globally.
The Apple iPhone Air has no physical SIM card slots.
The Apple iPhone Air is available in space black, cloud white, light gold, and sky blue.
The Apple iPhone Air has storage options of 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB.
The Apple iPhone Air starts at $999 in the U.S.
The Apple iPhone Air is designed to be lighter and more portable than the iPhone 17 series.
